text:
maria: Heads-up — partner marketplace reported a perf regression in large-token streams after last week's infra rollout. Can partnerships + runtime triage with priority? @aj @kelly

aj: I saw the support ticket. Repro steps incoming — appears only on p3-prod-gpu with CUDA kernels. Small repro script shows increased tail latency when KV cache hits drop.

samir: Partner (Paul from cloud partner) said their customers started seeing +60ms p99 token latencies, some timeouts on heavy batching. They're asking for a pinned safe stack while we investigate.

paul: Confirming — we rolled their image, saw spike after moving to driver 535.60 + CUDA 12.2. Downgrading to 535.54 + CUDA 12.1 resolved it for them. Not a full rollback yet, but it looks correlated.

kelly: Thanks. Can we get exact kernel traces? aj, can you paste the `nvidia-smi topo` + `dmesg` snippets from the repro box? Also propose temporary release gate to prevent 535.60 from being pushed to marketplace images.

aj: Paste logs:

```
# nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version --format=csv
name, driver_version
A100, 535.60

# tail -n 50 /var/log/syslog | grep -i nvidia
Mar 21 12:03:12 kernel: NVRM: GPU Lockup - switching to updatemode
```

aj: Repro script (quick):
```
client = RedwoodClient(...)
for i in range(100):
  resp = client.stream_generate(prompt, max_tokens=2048)
  measure_tail_latency(resp)
```

maria: Partnership ask summarized: 1) temporary pin on marketplace images, 2) clear rollback playbook, 3) joint announcement/mitigation note for customers if we escalate. Who owns the pin? platform or marketplace partner?

samir: Partnership owning comms; engineering owns pin gating. I'll coordinate on the comms draft with Paul and legal if needed.

kelly: I'll open a gating PR to the marketplace image repo to set driver -> `535.54` and CUDA -> `12.1.0` until runtime confirms compatibility. Also adding a CI check that runs the small repro for p99 regression.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy triggered for marketplace/images/prod -> commit 3f9a2d

paul: Appreciate the quick action. If you need driver binaries or a repro cluster from our side, we can provision a 12-node cluster in us-west for 48 hours.

nvidia-eng: Noted. We're re-running our driver test-farm against the repro. Early signal suggests a scheduling regression in 535.60 affecting continuous small-kernel launches. Will update with root-cause or micro-patch ETA.

kelly: Action items:
- aj: full kernel traces + perf profile (by EOD) [assigned]
- kelly: gating PR + CI check (2 hours) [assigned]
- samir/maria: comms draft + partner sync (ASAP) [assigned]
- nvidia-eng: status + patch ETA (TBD)

aj: uploading perf profile to /mnt/shared/perf/1763612345/profile.tar.gz

maria: Thanks all. I'll schedule a quick 15m huddle at 12:45 to agree on the customer advisory language. If we get a micro-patch from NVIDIA, we can test on the partner cluster.

paul: 12:45 works. We'll stand by to accept a test-run.

kelly: remote note: gate config snippet for ops:

```
GATE_DRIVERS={
  "allowed": ["535.54"],
  "blocked": ["535.60"]
}
```

maria: Closing loop — please post final status here after the 12:45 call. :thumbsup:
